verdict.rationale: GitLab's first-party docs describe a built-in Duo Agent Platform that lets users "delegate routine tasks, from code refactoring and security scans to research, to specialized AI agents." Agents can turn issues into merge requests and review code, and Chat has project-wide context. The platform also supports custom agents and flows, session tracking, and human-in-the-loop approvals. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that task delegation works as documented.
